envelope.description: Each reviewer refuses its own party's work on the daemon side

body.title: Each reviewer refuses its own party's work on the daemon side
body.summary: reviewArtifactFile refuses a daemon-authored artifact before any provider call, which covers the TUI review service. The daemon workflow run no longer calls it for its opt-in finalize review: it skips the review, says in its progress that the artifact needs a controller review, and returns no review. The daemon code review reads the build's author from the BUILD record's json and refuses daemon-authored code. The comments on the run option and the finalize step are rewritten.
acceptanceChecks: reviewArtifactFile on a daemon-authored DEF and on a daemon-authored LLD throws a same-party error and makes no provider call; a controller-authored or unknown-author artifact is reviewed
The TUI review service surfaces that refusal with a message naming a controller review or an override
A daemon workflow run started with review true makes no review call, emits the progress line, returns no review and leaves the artifact unstamped
The daemon code review sends an error frame for daemon-authored code and stamps nothing
